name: smm-panel/smm-panel
description: Self-hosted SMM reseller panel for PHP 8.1+ / MySQL shared hosting. Composer is optional: no third-party packages are used and app/bootstrap.php has its own autoloader.

suggest.ext-bcmath: Faster exact decimal arithmetic (a pure-PHP fallback is built in)
suggest.ext-gd: Re-encodes uploaded images to strip hidden payloads

runtime-requirements.note: Enforced by the application at runtime (app/Core/Requirements.php), intentionally not declared as Composer platform requirements so a host's automatic `composer install` (run with its CLI PHP) cannot block deployment.

scripts.lint: find app routes config cron public resources tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
